items.title: CBRE Group (CBRE) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Turn More Positive
items.summary: Price target work on CBRE Group has tightened, with fair value moving from US$177.17 to US$181.25 as part of the latest analyst update. This shift lines up with a more constructive tone in recent Street research, where several firms have lifted targets into a US$174 to US$190 range while debating how AI and commercial real estate trends could shape earnings.
